paths.name: @/lib/apiClient
paths.message: P1.1 dual-auth gate — teacher surface: use fetchWithTeacherAuth (Firebase teacher token). fetchWithAuth sends the anonymous-group student token → 401 for a teacher (shipped 4+ times). If this endpoint is genuinely dual-audience, call it from a src/lib/* module that lets the caller pick the token. See CLAUDE.md 'Anonymous-Group Auth'.

paths.name: @/lib/apiClient
paths.message: P1.1 dual-auth gate — student/group surface: use fetchWithAuth (anonymous-group token). fetchWithTeacherAuth sends the Firebase teacher token → null for a student → 401. If this endpoint is genuinely dual-audience, call it from a src/lib/* module that lets the caller pick the token. See CLAUDE.md 'Anonymous-Group Auth'.
